intro.text: A Veden Dustbringer in King Taravangian's contingent of Dalinar Kholin's coalition, who uses her spren as a Shardblade to work the Oathgates.
A Veden Dustbringer and member of Taravangian's Diagram, who uses her spren as a Shardblade to work the Oathgates for Dalinar Kholin's coalition.

items.text: Malata was supposedly part of Taravangian's project to have members of the Diagram try to bond spren, though she claims she approached him only at her spren Spark's suggestion, implying she was already bonded.

Part of Taravangian's contingent in the coalition, Malata used her spren, with some guidance from Navani Kholin, to unlock and activate the Veden Oathgate, carrying herself and the rest of the contingent to Urithiru.

With a Radiant's Shardblade, Malata was often given the job of opening Oathgates for the coalition. She accepted it obediently, though she once expressed distrust of the Alethi and seemed sceptical of the True Desolation.

When the Diagram decided Taravangian must replace Dalinar as leader of the coalition, Malata spied on Dalinar through Spark. What she learned, including his visions in which he spoke with Odium, was used to undermine the coalition's trust in him.

During the Battle of Thaylen Field, on the Diagram's orders, Malata opened Kholinar's Oathgate to let a strike force of Odium's singers into Urithiru, part of Taravangian's plan to persuade Odium to spare part of humanity.
Malata is usually present at the coalition's meetings in Urithiru, including the one where it agrees to fight in Emul and send an expedition to Lasting Integrity to persuade more honorspren to bond.

appearance.text: A middle-aged, lighteyed Veden woman with short, black, boyish hair. She dresses in a Thaylen style, with a skirt, leggings and thick boots, and wears gloves on both hands.

personality.text: Told by Spark that her Order dislikes the name Dustbringer, Malata calls herself a Releaser, though those around her still call her a Dustbringer.

Malata is confident even around royalty and unafraid to break social conventions, such as baring her safehand to demonstrate her powers. She cares little about the ethics of the Diagram's actions or about her spren's wish to punish humans for the Recreance; she seems to care only about enjoying her work.
